channel.title: MediaToday Co Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Police arrest two men over synthetic cannabis possession
item.description: Two men have been arrested in separate incidents after they were found to be in possession of synthetic cannabis and cash

item.title: Government to sign €276 million agreement to keep childcare free
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela also announced that government will embark on a reform of family law following a public consultation process

item.title: Police catch two stray puppies running in the middle of the road
item.description: Animal Welfare officials came to the site and confirmed that the dogs weren’t chipped, and so were collected by the officials

item.title: Emergency vet clinic to open in Fgura
item.description: The clinic will be open in Reggie Miller Square between 8pm and 8am starting on Monday

item.title: Were not there yet, Borg tells supporters after promising MaltaToday survey
item.description: PN leader Alex Borg says the MaltaToday survey confirmed an end to the party’s previous heavy election defeats, as he warned against overconfidence

item.title: CPD issues yellow weather warning for Monday
item.description: The Civil Protection Department said that weather conditions are expected to worsen between 1am and 4am, as the wind is expected to strengthen overnight and will reach Force 7 throughout the day

item.title: Cadaver found at Ġnejna Bay
item.description: Police say the deceased appears to have been a woman, but identifying the victim will be difficult due to the stage of decomposition

item.title: Controversy re-awakened: Case officer recommends redevelopment of Qala ruin into ‘agricultural store’
item.description: Despite being presented as a limited restoration, the Environment and Resources Authority has warned that approving the Qala proposal could open the door to a fully-fledged dwelling in ODZ, raising concerns over incremental development in a sensitive rural area

item.title: Beyond the numbers… the winner is!
item.description: If there is a segment of people who need to be addressed, it is the group that is arguing that they will not vote. This group is sending a message. The message is loud and clear and yet I do not see an efficient political riposte to them…

item.title: Pilot project to start lampuki season earlier gets commission go-ahead
item.description: A request for a pilot project to launch the lampuki season early, following reports of earlier migration patterns, is accepted by European Commission
